title: Exact PR #74 runtime matrix lacked causal hosted output
title_de: Der Runtime-Matrix des exakten PR #74 fehlte kausale Hosted-Ausgabe
profile: Historical Parent PR #74 hosted diagnosis heads 7238c9d0a0902affbf7dfae1d7f96d6603d80f89 and 6809e348ad043bf3fcfd9b90d963882cc2fb2; current master lacks the b28b874 bounded diagnostic
observed_behavior: Historical exact run 30196090664/job 89777788658 exposed only the fixed nested matrix-log pathname. Commit b28b8744765a2cac6e3cf91f7bd3070d49d7774d then exposed causal output in historical exact run 30197684223/job 89782035387. That commit is not an ancestor of current master 59aba762f2d852fd917079ca8519e4ea7f49169c: the current lightweight governance workflow contains neither the bounded diagnostic nor the strict producer path, and its workflow test asserts that absence.
observed_behavior_de: Der historische exakte Run 30196090664/Job 89777788658 legte nur den festen verschachtelten Matrix-Log-Pfad offen. Commit b28b8744765a2cac6e3cf91f7bd3070d49d7774d legte danach im historischen exakten Run 30197684223/Job 89782035387 kausale Ausgabe offen. Dieser Commit ist kein Vorfahr des aktuellen Master 59aba762f2d852fd917079ca8519e4ea7f49169c: Der heutige leichte Governance-Workflow enthält weder die begrenzte Diagnose noch den strikten Producer-Pfad, und sein Workflow-Test verlangt diese Abwesenheit.
expected_behavior: A current, explicitly selected control must either provide equivalent bounded, regular-file-only causal observability for a failed strict producer while retaining fail-closed behavior, or document an authorized replacement decision with evidence; neither has been established by this reconciliation.
expected_behavior_de: Ein aktuelles, ausdrücklich ausgewähltes Control muss entweder gleichwertige begrenzte, nur-reguläre-Datei-kausale Beobachtbarkeit für einen fehlgeschlagenen strikten Producer bei erhaltenem Fail-Closed-Verhalten bereitstellen oder eine autorisierte Replacement-Entscheidung mit Evidenz dokumentieren; beides ist durch diese Abstimmung nicht belegt.
impact: The historical observability result remains traceable, but its current applicability is unverified. The separately tracked cross-repository owner-root defect in FND-CROSS-0008 continues to block fresh legitimate runtime evidence and integration.
impact_de: Das historische Observability-Ergebnis bleibt nachvollziehbar, seine aktuelle Anwendbarkeit ist jedoch unbestätigt. Der separat verfolgte Cross-Repository-Owner-Root-Defekt in FND-CROSS-0008 blockiert weiterhin frische legitime Runtime-Evidence und die Integration.
preconditions: The historical PR #74 exact head ran the strict/full producer.
Current master uses the lightweight verified-report-governance workflow.
No current equivalent strict-producer observability run has been retained for this reconciliation.
reproduction: Run git merge-base --is-ancestor b28b8744765a2cac6e3cf91f7bd3070d49d7774d 59aba762f2d852fd917079ca8519e4ea7f49169c and observe exit 1.

Inspect .github/workflows/verified-report-governance.yml on current master and confirm that it invokes the lightweight report-governance path rather than verified-report-run or the bounded diagnostic.
Inspect tests.test_ci_security_workflows.CiSecurityWorkflowTest.test_verified_report_governance_stays_lightweight and confirm it asserts the absence of the former strict-runtime terms.

evidence.command: Read-only inspection of GitHub Actions exact-head workflow/job log and bounded diagnostic output
Read-only GitHub Actions exact-head workflow/job log inspection plus source-to-sink review

root_cause: The earlier closure assumed that b28b874's bounded fixed-log diagnostic remained reachable in the current workflow/runner scope. Current-master ancestry and workflow-contract inspection disprove that assumption; no current replacement control has been evidenced.
root_cause_de: Die frühere Schließung nahm an, dass die begrenzte Fixed-Log-Diagnose von b28b874 im aktuellen Workflow-/Runner-Scope erreichbar bleibe. Current-Master-Ancestry und Workflow-Contract-Inspektion widerlegen diese Annahme; ein aktuelles Replacement-Control ist nicht belegt.
proposed_remediation: Reassess the current control design. If strict producer evidence remains required, restore or replace the bounded fixed-log diagnostic without weakening the terminal gate, then validate it on a current strict-producer run. If it was intentionally retired, obtain an authorized, evidence-backed replacement decision. This reconciliation changes no product workflow, Framework, MRTS, gitlink, scanner, gate, or risk control.
proposed_remediation_de: Das aktuelle Control-Design neu bewerten. Falls strikte Producer-Evidence weiterhin erforderlich ist, die begrenzte Fixed-Log-Diagnose wiederherstellen oder gleichwertig ersetzen, ohne das terminale Gate zu schwächen, und sie auf einem aktuellen Strict-Producer-Run validieren. Falls sie bewusst retirert wurde, eine autorisierte, evidenzgestützte Replacement-Entscheidung einholen. Diese Abstimmung ändert keinen Produkt-Workflow, kein Framework, MRTS, Gitlink, Scanner, Gate oder Risikocontrol.
acceptance_criteria: A current selected control is identified and its relationship to the historical strict producer is documented.

If strict producer evidence remains required, a current bounded regular-file-only diagnostic exposes the fixed run-ID-derived log while failed evidence remains rejected and the terminal gate remains fail-closed.
If the path is intentionally retired, an authorized, evidence-backed equivalent control or explicit retirement decision is recorded.
The current evidence is bound to the exact current source/CI head and does not infer proof from historical PR #74 runs.
validation_plan: Read-only reassessment completed: b28b874 is not an ancestor of current master 59aba762f2d852fd917079ca8519e4ea7f49169c; current governance workflow and its lightweight-contract test were inspected.

For a future remediation, run tests.test_runtime_path_security and tests.test_generated_report_evidence_integrity, make check-ci-security-contract, and a current strict-producer execution using a registered external BUILD_ROOT.
For a legitimate matrix failure, verify bounded fixed 04-log observability without accepting failed evidence; otherwise validate the documented equivalent replacement control.
regression_tests: tests/test_ci_security_workflows.py (current lightweight workflow contract; it does not validate the historical bounded strict-producer diagnostic)
legitimate_control_tests: The current lightweight workflow contract explicitly excludes verified-report-run, the strict evidence gate, runtime-matrix-all, ALLOW_RUNTIME_DOWNLOADS, and ALLOW_RUNTIME_BUILDS.
A future selected strict-producer path must preserve fail-closed terminal evidence behavior and bounded regular-file-only output.
deduplication_note: Not a duplicate of FND-PARENT-0053: that record owns the PCRE2 digest-provenance defect, which this run no longer reproduces. This record owned the post-Apache matrix observability gap; the discovered owner-root defect is independently tracked as FND-CROSS-0008.
residual_risk: No failed matrix output is accepted as evidence, but the historical bounded diagnostic is not currently reachable and no equivalent current control has been proven. The separately tracked owner-root defect remains blocked in FND-CROSS-0008 without risk acceptance.
residual_risk_de: Keine fehlgeschlagene Matrix-Ausgabe wird als Evidence akzeptiert, aber die historische begrenzte Diagnose ist aktuell nicht erreichbar und ein gleichwertiges aktuelles Control ist nicht bewiesen. Der separat verfolgte Owner-Root-Defekt bleibt in FND-CROSS-0008 ohne Risikoakzeptanz blockiert.

history.detail: Run 30196090664/job 89777788658 at 7238c9d0a0902affbf7dfae1d7f96d6603d80f89 passed preparation/readiness and Apache output, then failed at runtime-matrix-all-runtime rc=2 without publishing the fixed matrix-log contents.

Run 30197684223/job 89782035387 exposed Apache and NGINX cache-owner-root containment failures. The historical observability acceptance criteria were verified; FND-CROSS-0008 owns the separate repair.

Read-only ancestry check proved b28b8744765a2cac6e3cf91f7bd3070d49d7774d is not an ancestor of then-current master 522e791c1efa21da6101f9a0908d5e185736b518. The current verified-report-governance was intentionally lightweight and its contract test required the absence of the historical strict-producer terms. The record was returned to active in_progress pending current equivalent-control evidence or an authorized retirement decision.

After rebase to current master 59aba762f2d852fd917079ca8519e4ea7f49169c, b28b874 remained unreachable and test_verified_report_governance_stays_lightweight passed, confirming that the lightweight workflow still excludes the historical strict-producer path. The record remains active in_progress.
